verdicts.rationale: config/auth/jwks.json replaces the published key set with kid-2026-08 and drops the previous key instead of publishing both (@@ -1,8 +1,8), while services/auth/keys.py starts signing with settings.active_kid. Verifiers that cached the old JWKS reject new tokens with 'unknown key id kid-2026-08', matching the alert exactly. It shipped 15 minutes before the alert.
A retry loop around the auth cache warmup (services/auth/cache.py, +12/-3, four hours old); it affects cold-start latency, not key ids in token validation.
